CORRIGENDUM
This is in reference to Advt. No.N/A dated 02nd January, 2025 for the post of 01 Guest
Faculty in Economics of the Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The applicants are also requested to email the duly filled application form alongwith
supporting documents to ecochairperson@pu.ac.in by due date i.e. 16th January, 2025 for
the post of one (01) Guest faculty in Economies in the Department of Economics, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.
How to Apply:
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf).
i. The candidate are required to submit one hard copy of duly filled form along with
copies of two set of attested certificate and other supporting documents to the office
of the Chairperson, Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh latest
by 16th January, 2025, 05:00 p.m.
ii. All shortlisted candidates called for the interview shall be intimated by e-mail/ phone.
No separate interview letter shall be sent. The Interview will be conduct on sam
date i.e. 22nd January, 2025 at 10:00 onwards.
iii. All applicants are advised to report at 9:30 a.m. and bring their original certificates
and other relevant documents for verification at the time of interview.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistant from any
agency till they are teaching in Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a
Guest Faculty.
No TA/DA will be paid for the same.
Sd/-
Chairperson
